notes: N097. Same data as fig14 with the AUROC printed in every tile (user request 11-27). Tile = AUROC of row lineage vs column lineage on BSCCM, record ensemble: every true A cell and every true B cell gets the score z(predicted marker of A) - z(predicted marker of B); AUROC = fraction of (A cell, B cell) pairs in which the A cell scores higher (.5 = coin flip, 1 = perfect). Lineages = measured positives of each marker on its own single-stain slide of the test draw. a train draw 1 -> test draw 0, b train draw 0 -> test draw 1, c mean. Cells per lineage (a / b): T 89/692, B 39/10, NK 34/112, monocyte 334/273, neutrophil 504/1,733, basophil/pDC 50/49.
significance: two-sided; Holm-corrected over all comparisons of a panel (one family per panel); * <0.05 ** <0.01 *** <0.001 **** <0.0001
